name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students (CSSS)
description: A central government merit-cum-means scholarship scheme by the Department of Higher Education providing financial assistance to meritorious students from low-income families to meet their day-to-day expenses while pursuing higher studies.
benefits: Rs. 12,000 per annum at Graduation level for the first three years of College and University courses, and Rs. 20,000 per annum at Post-Graduation level. For 5-year professional/integrated courses, Rs. 20,000 per annum in the 4th and 5th year via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).
eligibility: Must be above the 80th percentile of successful candidates in the relevant stream in Class XII board examination.
Must be pursuing regular degree courses (not correspondence or distance mode) in recognized colleges/institutions in India.
Gross parental/family annual income must not exceed Rs. 4,50,000.
Must not be receiving any other central or state scholarship or fee reimbursement.
documents: Valid Family Income Certificate issued by a competent state authority
Bonafide Student Certificate / College Admission Proof
application_process:
1. Visit the official National Scholarship Portal (NSP) at scholarships.gov.in.
2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using your Aadhaar and mobile number.
3. Log in and select 'Central Sector Scheme of Scholarships for College and University Students'.
4. Fill in academic, personal, and bank details, and upload required documents.
5. Submit the online application before the closing date and submit a printed copy to your institution for verification.

name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students
description: An AICTE initiative dedicated to empowering young women to pursue technical education (Degree and Diploma levels) by providing financial assistance for tuition fees, books, laptops, and educational equipment.
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum for every year of study (maximum 4 years for first-year admitted Degree students and maximum 3 years for Diploma students) as a lump sum towards payment of college fee, purchase of computer, stationery, books, equipment, and software.
eligibility: Applicant must be a female student admitted to the first year or second year (through lateral entry) of a technical Degree or Diploma course in an AICTE-approved institution.
Maximum two girl children per family are eligible to apply.
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 during the current financial year.
documents: AICTE Institution Admission Letter and Tuition Fee Receipt
Family Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar or competent authority
Declaration by parents confirming maximum two girl children applying
application_process:
1. Register on the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Navigate to AICTE Schemes and select 'Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students'.
3. Complete the application form with AICTE institution details and upload scanned documents.
4. Submit the form online before 30 November 2026 for Institute-level and State DTE verification.

name: Karnataka State Scholarship Portal (SSP) Post-Matric & Vidyasiri Scholarship
description: A Government of Karnataka scholarship program providing fee concession, maintenance allowance, and food & accommodation stipend (Vidyasiri) to post-matric students domiciled in Karnataka.
benefits: Under Vidyasiri (Food & Accommodation Scheme), eligible students who do not secure admission in departmental hostels receive a stipend of Rs. 1,500 per month for 10 months (Rs. 15,000 per year), along with post-matric tuition fee reimbursement as applicable per category.
eligibility: Must be a permanent resident (domicile) of Karnataka.
Must be enrolled in a post-matric course (PUC, Degree, Diploma, Engineering, Medical, or Postgraduate) in a recognized institution.
Annual family income must be within Rs. 2,50,000 (up to Rs. 1,00,000 for certain OBC categories under Vidyasiri).
For Vidyasiri accommodation benefit, residence must be at least 5 km away from the college (or student resides in a different town/city).
documents: Aadhaar Card of Student and Parents
Karnataka Caste and Income Certificate (with RD Number)
College Registration Number / SATS ID / University Registration Number
Previous Year Marks Card and SSLC Registration Number
Hostel or Local Residence Proof and Fee Receipt
application_process:
1. Visit the Karnataka State Scholarship Portal at ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in.
2. Create an SSP account using your Aadhaar number and complete e-KYC.
3. Enter your SATS ID / University registration number, RD number of Income/Caste certificate, and e-Attestation numbers.
4. Submit the online application before the closing date and track status on the SSP portal.

name: Karnataka Yuva Nidhi Scheme
description: A flagship Government of Karnataka scheme providing monthly unemployment financial assistance and skill training support to recent graduates and diploma holders in Karnataka while they seek employment.
target_group: Graduates and Diploma Holders in Karnataka
application_end_date: No Fixed Deadline (Monthly Self-Declaration by 25th of Every Month)
benefits: Monthly financial assistance of Rs. 3,000 for unemployed degree graduates and Rs. 1,500 for unemployed diploma holders for up to 2 years or until the beneficiary secures employment, along with free skill development training under Kaushalkar.
eligibility: Must be a domicile resident of Karnataka who has studied for at least 6 years in Karnataka.
Must have recently completed a Degree or Diploma and remained unemployed for at least 180 days after graduation.
Must not be currently pursuing higher studies or employed in government/private sectors or self-employed with loan schemes.
documents: Aadhaar Card linked with mobile number and bank account
Degree or Provisional Degree / Diploma Certificate and Marksheets
SSLC / PUC / Education Certificates proving 6 years of study in Karnataka
Domicile / Residence Proof (Ration Card or Voter ID)
application_process:
1. Visit the Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal (sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in).
2. Log in and select the 'Yuva Nidhi Scheme' application form.
3. Enter your University Registration Number / Diploma Number for automated verification via NAD.
4. Complete Aadhaar authentication and submit monthly self-declaration before the 25th of each month to receive DBT transfers.

name: Karnataka Gruha Lakshmi Scheme
description: A women empowerment welfare scheme by the Government of Karnataka providing direct monthly financial assistance to the woman head of the household to support family livelihood and nutrition.
target_group: Women Heads of Households in Karnataka
benefits: Rs. 2,000 per month transferred directly to the Aadhaar-linked bank account of the woman listed as the head of the family on the household Ration Card.
eligibility: Applicant must be the woman listed as Head of the Family in an Antyodaya, BPL (Below Poverty Line), or APL Ration Card issued by the Government of Karnataka.
Neither the woman applicant nor her husband should be an income tax payer or GST filer.
Only one woman per household Ration Card can avail the benefit.
documents: Antyodaya, BPL, or APL Ration Card showing applicant as Head of Family
Aadhaar Card of Applicant and Spouse (if applicable)
Active Mobile Number for OTP verification
application_process:
1. Apply online via the Seva Sindhu Guarantee Schemes Portal or visit the nearest Karnataka One, Bangalore One, Grama One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra.
2. Provide Ration Card number, Aadhaar number, and bank account details.
3. Complete biometric/OTP verification and collect the acknowledgment receipt.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN)
description: A central sector income support scheme by the Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare providing assured financial assistance to landholding farmer families across India to meet agricultural input and household needs.
application_start_date: Open Year-Round (Installment Cycles: Apr–Jul, Aug–Nov, Dec–Mar)
application_end_date: No Fixed Closing Date (e-KYC Required Before Next Installment Release)
benefits: Financial benefit of Rs. 6,000 per year payable in three equal four-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each, transferred directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmer families via DBT.
eligibility: Must be a landholding farmer family with cultivable land recorded in state/UT land records.
Institutional landholders, current/former constitutional post holders, government employees, pensioners receiving Rs. 10,000+ monthly, and income tax payers are excluded.
e-KYC on the PM-KISAN portal is mandatory to receive installments.
documents: Land Ownership Documents (RTC / Pahani / Khatauni / Khasra)
application_process:
1. Visit the official PM-KISAN portal at pmkisan.gov.in.
2. Click on 'New Farmer Registration' under the Farmers Corner section.
3. Enter Aadhaar number, select your State, complete OTP verification, and fill in landholding details.
4. Alternatively, visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Agriculture Department Patwari/Nodal Officer.

name: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana (PMFBY)
description: A government-sponsored crop insurance scheme that provides comprehensive insurance coverage and financial support to farmers in the event of failure of any of the notified crops due to natural calamities, pests, and diseases.
application_end_date: Kharif Cut-Off: 31 July 2026 | Rabi Cut-Off: 31 December 2026
benefits: Comprehensive risk insurance against crop yield losses from sowing to post-harvest at highly subsidized farmer premium rates: maximum 2% of sum insured for Kharif crops, 1.5% for Rabi crops, and 5% for annual commercial/horticultural crops.
eligibility: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing notified crops in notified areas are eligible.
Must have an insurable interest in the notified crop and apply before the seasonal cut-off date.
documents: Land Possession Certificate / RTC / Tenancy Agreement
Sowing Certificate issued by Village Panchayat or Agriculture Officer
Bank Account Passbook with IFSC code
application_process:
1. Visit the official PMFBY portal at pmfby.gov.in or apply through your Kisan Credit Card (KCC) bank branch or CSC.
2. Register as a farmer and enter crop sowing and land survey details.
3. Pay the nominal farmer share of premium online or through the bank before the seasonal cut-off date and save the policy receipt.

name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana (AB PM-JAY)
description: The world's largest public health assurance scheme providing free cashless secondary and tertiary hospitalization care to economically vulnerable families and senior citizens aged 70 and above across India.
benefits: Cashless health insurance cover of up to Rs. 5,00,000 per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization at over 29,000 empanelled public and private hospitals across India. Covers pre-existing diseases from day one, plus 3 days of pre-hospitalization and 15 days of post-hospitalization expenses.
eligibility: Families listed in the SECC 2011 database or holding an eligible state BPL/NFSA Ration Card.
All senior citizens aged 70 years and above are eligible for Rs. 5 lakh cover regardless of income.
No cap on family size, age, or gender for eligible households.
documents: Ration Card / Family ID / NFSA Card
application_process:
1. Check eligibility on beneficiary.nha.gov.in or the Ayushman App using your mobile number and Aadhaar.
2. Complete Aadhaar e-KYC online or at an empanelled hospital (Pradhan Mantri Arogya Mitra desk) or CSC.
3. Download your Ayushman Card and present it at any empanelled hospital for cashless treatment.

name: AICTE Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students
description: A scholarship scheme implemented by AICTE aimed at providing encouragement and financial support to specially-abled students to pursue technical education at the Degree or Diploma level.
target_group: Students with Disabilities in Technical Courses
benefits: Rs. 50,000 per annum for every year of study (up to 4 years for Degree and 3 years for Diploma) as a lump sum for payment of college fees, purchase of computer, books, stationery, software, and assistive equipment.
eligibility: Applicant must have a benchmark disability of not less than 40%.
Must be admitted to the first year or second year (through lateral entry) of a Degree or Diploma level course in an AICTE-approved institution.
Family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 8,00,000 per annum.
documents: Disability Certificate (40% or more) / UDID Card issued by competent medical authority
College Admission Letter and Tuition Fee Receipt
application_process:
1. Visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Register and apply under AICTE 'Saksham Scholarship Scheme for Specially-Abled Students'.
3. Upload your UDID/Disability certificate, income certificate, and academic records.
4. Submit the form before 30 November 2026 for institute verification.

name: ADIP Scheme (Assistance to Disabled Persons for Purchase/Fitting of Aids and Appliances)
description: A central scheme by the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment to assist needy persons with disabilities (Divyangjan) in procuring durable, sophisticated, and scientifically manufactured modern assistive aids and appliances.
application_end_date: No Fixed Deadline (Apply Online or at ALIMCO Camps Anytime)
benefits: 100% full cost subsidy on assistive devices (tricycles, motorized wheelchairs, prosthetics, hearing aids, Braille kits, smart canes, cochlear implants) for beneficiaries with monthly income up to Rs. 22,500 (Rs. 2,70,000/year), and 50% subsidy for monthly income between Rs. 22,501 and Rs. 30,000 (Rs. 3,60,000/year).
eligibility: Must be an Indian citizen of any age with a 40% or more Disability Certificate (UDID).
Monthly income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 30,000 (Rs. 3,60,000 annually).
Must not have received assistance for the same purpose from any government/NGO source during the last 3 years (1 year for children below 12 years).
documents: UDID Card / Disability Certificate (40% or above)
Income Certificate issued by Revenue Authority / MP / MLA / Gazetted Officer
application_process:
1. Register online on the ALIMCO / DEPwD portal or attend an ADIP assessment camp organized by ALIMCO, DDRCs, or National Institutes.
2. Undergo assessment by rehabilitation specialists.
3. Collect the prescribed assistive aid/appliance during the distribution camp.

name: PM-YASASVI Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education & Post-Matric Scholarship for OBC, EBC and DNT Students
description: A Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment scholarship scheme providing tuition fee reimbursement, living expenses, and academic allowance to meritorious students belonging to OBC, EBC, and DNT categories.
target_group: OBC, EBC, and DNT Category Students
benefits: Academic allowance from Rs. 5,000 to Rs. 20,000 per annum plus tuition fee reimbursement for Post-Matric students, and up to Rs. 75,000 to Rs. 1,25,000 per year for students studying in notified Top Class schools and colleges.
eligibility: Must belong to Other Backward Class (OBC), Economically Backward Class (EBC), or De-notified, Nomadic, and Semi-Nomadic Tribes (DNT).
Annual parental/family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
Must be studying in a recognized post-matric institution or notified top-class school/college.
documents: OBC / EBC / DNT Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
Fee Receipt and Institution Bonafide Certificate
application_process:
1. Visit the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).
2. Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) and log in.
3. Select the PM-YASASVI Post-Matric or Top Class Education scheme under the Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment.
4. Upload documents and submit before 15 November 2026 for institutional and state verification.

name: Post-Matric Scholarship for SC and ST Students
description: A centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing complete compulsory non-refundable fee reimbursement and annual academic maintenance allowance to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing post-matriculation or post-secondary courses.
benefits: 100% reimbursement of compulsory non-refundable tuition and course fees, plus an annual academic allowance ranging from Rs. 2,500 to Rs. 13,500 per year depending on course group and hosteller/day-scholar status (10% extra allowance for students with disabilities).
eligibility: Applicant must belong to Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) category.
Must be pursuing a recognized post-matriculation or post-secondary course (Class 11 to Ph.D.).
Total annual family income from all sources must not exceed Rs. 2,50,000.
documents: SC / ST Caste Certificate with barcode/RD number
Previous Exam Marksheets and Admission Proof
application_process:
1. Apply through the National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in) or respective State Scholarship Portal (e.g., SSP in Karnataka, MahaDBT in Maharashtra).
2. Complete Freeship Card generation prior to admission.
3. Upload academic and caste/income certificates and submit before 30 November 2026 to your college nodal officer.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Vikas Yojana (PMKVY 4.0) & Skill India Digital
description: The flagship skill development scheme of the Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship (MSDE) enabling Indian youth and students to take up free, industry-relevant skill training, AI/digital courses, and certification.
application_end_date: No Fixed Deadline (Continuous Online & Offline Enrollment)
benefits: 100% free short-term industry training (150–600 hours), future-skills courses (AI, Drone, Coding, Mechatronics, Soft Skills), Government-recognized NSQF Skill Certification, and placement/entrepreneurship guidance.
eligibility: Must be an Indian citizen aged between 15 and 45 years.
Open to college/school students, dropouts, and unemployed youth seeking vocational or digital skill enhancement.
application_process:
1. Visit the Skill India Digital Hub portal at skillindiadigital.gov.in.
2. Register as a 'Learner/Participant' using your mobile number and complete Aadhaar e-KYC.
3. Browse online courses or locate a nearby PMKVY Training Centre (Pradhan Mantri Kaushal Kendra) and enroll for free.

name: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: A central sector scheme by the Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises providing end-to-end holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople working with their hands and tools.
application_end_date: 31 March 2028 (Currently Open at All CSC Centres)
benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate and ID card, toolkit e-voucher worth up to Rs. 15,000, skill training with a stipend of Rs. 500/day, and collateral-free enterprise development loans up to Rs. 3,00,000 (Rs. 1 Lakh in 1st tranche + Rs. 2 Lakh in 2nd tranche) at a concessional 5% interest rate.
eligibility: Must be an artisan or craftsperson working with hands and tools in one of the 18 notified family-based traditional trades (e.g., Tailor, Carpenter, Blacksmith, Potter, Mason, Cobbler, Barber, Goldsmith).
Minimum age of 18 years on the date of registration.
Must not have availed loans under PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, or Mudra in the past 5 years (unless fully repaid).
application_process:
1. Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or check pmvishwakarma.gov.in.
2. Complete Aadhaar biometric verification and register under your traditional trade.
3. Undergo three-tier verification (Gram Panchayat/ULB, District Committee, Screening Committee) to receive your Vishwakarma ID and benefits.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana (PMMY)
description: A flagship initiative providing collateral-free micro and small business loans up to Rs. 20 Lakh (under Shishu, Kishore, Tarun, and Tarun Plus categories) to non-corporate, non-farm small/micro enterprises.
target_group: Entrepreneurs, Self-Employed, and Small Business Owners
application_end_date: No Fixed Deadline (Apply Anytime via JanSamarth or Banks)
benefits: Collateral-free institutional credit under four stages: Shishu (loans up to Rs. 50,000), Kishore (Rs. 50,000 to Rs. 5 Lakh), Tarun (Rs. 5 Lakh to Rs. 10 Lakh), and Tarun Plus (Rs. 10 Lakh to Rs. 20 Lakh for entrepreneurs who have successfully repaid previous Tarun loans).
eligibility: Any Indian citizen aged 18–65 years who has a business plan for a non-farm income-generating activity such as manufacturing, processing, trading, or service sector.
Applicant must not be a defaulter to any bank or financial institution.
documents: Business Address Proof and Registration (Udyam Registration if available)
Brief Business Plan / Quotation of Machinery or Items to be purchased
Caste Certificate (if applying for SC/ST/OBC/Women interest concessions)
application_process:
1. Visit the JanSamarth Portal (jansamarth.in) or Mudra Portal (mudra.org.in).
2. Check eligibility under Business Activity Loans and select Shishu/Kishore/Tarun.
3. Submit the online application to your preferred public/private sector bank or NBFC.

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (PMAY 2.0 - Urban & Gramin)
description: A central government 'Housing for All' mission providing financial subsidy and direct grant assistance to economically weaker sections (EWS), low-income groups (LIG), and houseless rural families to construct or purchase a pucca house.
benefits: Up to Rs. 1.20 Lakh – Rs. 1.30 Lakh direct financial grant under PMAY-Gramin (plus 90 days MGNREGA wage support and Rs. 12,000 for toilet construction), and up to Rs. 1.80 Lakh interest subsidy / Rs. 2.50 Lakh central assistance under PMAY-Urban 2.0.
eligibility: The beneficiary family must not own a pucca (all-weather) house anywhere in India.
Annual household income up to Rs. 3,00,000 for EWS and up to Rs. 6,00,000 for LIG categories.
Female ownership or co-ownership of the house is prioritized.
documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Affidavit stating no pucca house is owned in India
Land Ownership / Property Documents (for Beneficiary-Led Construction)
Bank Account Passbook and Ration Card
application_process:
1. For Urban areas, visit pmay-urban.gov.in and click on 'Apply for PMAY-U 2.0'.
2. For Rural areas, contact your Gram Panchayat Secretary / Block Development Officer with AwaasPlus details.
3. Complete Aadhaar authentication and upload income and land documents.

name: Pradhan Mantri Matru Vandana Yojana (PMMVY)
description: A maternity benefit scheme implemented by the Ministry of Women and Child Development providing direct cash incentives to pregnant women and lactating mothers for improved health, nutrition, and partial wage loss compensation.
application_start_date: Open Year-Round (From Pregnancy Registration at Anganwadi/Health Centre)
application_end_date: Within 730 Days from Date of Last Menstrual Period (LMP) or Child Birth
benefits: Cash incentive of Rs. 5,000 in two installments for the first living child upon pregnancy registration, antenatal check-up, and child vaccination. Under PMMVY 2.0 (Mission Shakti), an additional incentive of Rs. 6,000 is provided in a single installment if the second child is a girl.
eligibility: Pregnant women and lactating mothers aged 19 years and above.
Must belong to socially and economically disadvantaged sections (annual income < Rs. 8 Lakh, BPL/Ayushman card holders, SC/ST women, disabled women, or e-Shram/Kisan beneficiaries).
Must not be in regular central/state government or PSU employment.
documents: Eligibility Proof (BPL Ration Card / Ayushman Card / Income Certificate / e-Shram Card / Caste Certificate)
Child Birth Certificate and Immunization Record (for final installment)
application_process:
1. Visit the PMMVY portal (pmmvy.wcd.gov.in) or contact your local Anganwadi Worker (AWW) or ASHA worker.
2. Register using Citizen Login with your mobile number and Aadhaar.
3. Fill Form 1-A with MCP card details and upload required documents within the eligible window.

name: National Social Assistance Programme (IGNOAPS / IGNDPS / IGNWPS Pension Schemes)
description: A centrally sponsored social security pension scheme providing monthly financial pension support to senior citizens, widows, and persons with severe disabilities belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) households.
target_group: Senior Citizens, Widows, and Persons with Severe Disabilities
application_end_date: No Fixed Deadline (Rolling Applications Accepted at Seva Sindhu / e-District)
benefits: Monthly central and state combined pension ranging from Rs. 600 to Rs. 2,000 per month (depending on state top-up) transferred directly to the beneficiary's bank or post office account.
eligibility: Applicant must belong to a Below Poverty Line (BPL) or low-income household.
For Old Age Pension (IGNOAPS): Age must be 60 years or above.
For Widow Pension (IGNWPS): Female applicant aged 40–79 years who is widowed.
For Disability Pension (IGNDPS): Age 18 and above with severe or multiple disabilities (80% or more).
documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate / Voter ID / School Certificate)
Husband's Death Certificate (for Widow Pension) or UDID Certificate (for Disability Pension)
Bank or Post Office Account Passbook
application_process:
1. Visit the NSAP portal (nsap.nic.in), UMANG App, or State e-District / Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu portal.
2. Fill out the application form for the relevant pension category.
3. Submit the application online or at the Gram Panchayat / Taluk Office for verification by the Social Welfare Officer.
